author: Donna Ridge Ingle
text: Make sure the app you are using is Libre by Abbott.  They told me that was the true app to use.  Also make sure the app doesn't need an update.  And lastly, make sure your phone is still compatible.  My phone worked for a year before it finally didn't, and I had to buy a new phone.  Other than those things, I'm not sure.  Good luck to you!

author: Lori McGraw
text: This just happened with my new sensor. I had to actually touch the back of my phone to the sensor instead of just placing it near to the sensor and it worked. Usually just have to hover over it. I think it's an update on the app.
